purpose: Track time lost before substantive work so scheduler jitter, cold-start reconstruction, handoff recovery and worker longevity are optimized independently.

target.reason: A non-overlapping 900-second window needs at least 840 seconds left after prework overhead.

optimization_order: Do not add extra mandatory startup reads without evidence they protect a higher-value invariant.
Use control/ACTIVE_CONTROLS.json to make required reads explicit and prevent exploratory startup drift.
Keep rearm/verify first because losing continuation is worse than startup overhead.
Measure actual successor observation separately from expected due.
Prefer event/overlap continuation for product-level utilization because scheduler jitter can consume the entire 60-second margin even when reconstruction is fast.
next_action: Collect >=10 wake samples before tuning scheduled fallback phase from jitter statistics. Do not optimize a two-sample distribution prematurely.
